name: Non-harming (ahiṃsā)
method_summary: Non-harming of all beings is the mark of the noble one (Dhp 270), of the elder (261) and of the mind delighting in non-harming (300).

method_summary: The wise tame themselves as irrigators lead water and fletchers bend the arrow (Dhp 80, 145); the self-tamed is better than tamed horses and elephants (322-323); one who conquers oneself is the best of victors (103-104).
